# Comparisons of a graph node's Role in the cost model and the model-graph package, found by
# TestNoPriceDependsOnAFreeTextLabel (design SUB-20). SUB-20 says no price, size or engine
# decision depends on a free-text label. The cost model's decisions are typed now:
# holds_engine_kv on an Attention node and shared on a GroupedGEMM node, both set by the
# model-graph deriver and required by the validator.
#
# What is left is the validator resolving references between nodes of one document, which
# has to name a node by something: an aliases reference ("<layer kind>.<role>") and an
# architecture override's role (validate_refs.go). They decide no price; a rename that keeps
# the reference consistent changes nothing, which TestChangingALabelChangesNoPriceOrIsListed
# shows for every catalog model.
# The list may only shrink: the test fails on a new comparison and on a listed one that is gone.
spec/model/validate_refs.go: m.Role == role
spec/model/validate_refs.go: no.Role != ""
spec/model/validate_refs.go: no.Role == ""
